ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of latitude and longitude in a mid- to high-latitude sea area of the Southern Hemisphere. Australia can be seen in the middle-left part, and in the sea area east of Australia there is an island labeled Island A; its position and outline correspond to the New Zealand area. This region is located in the mid- to high latitudes of the Southern Hemisphere, close to the South Pacific and the peripheral sea area of Antarctica. Reasoning: In the mid- to high latitudes of the Southern Hemisphere, near Antarctica, there exists a major cold current flowing from west to east, namely the West Wind Drift. Island A is located near New Zealand east of Australia and is greatly influenced by this cold current. Therefore, the cold current that has a relatively large influence on Island A is the West Wind Drift.

method.method_draft: 先从图中定位甲岛：它位于澳大利亚以东、南半球中高纬度海域，形态和位置对应新西兰一带。再调用世界洋流分布知识：南半球中高纬度、环绕南极附近的主要寒流是自西向东流动的西风漂流。因此，对甲岛影响较大的寒流为西风漂流。
